new.s: Which institution designed the Prototype Fast Breeder Reactor (PFBR) at Kalpakkam?
o: Indira Gandhi Centre for Atomic Research (IGCAR)
new.x: IGCAR, Kalpakkam designed the PFBR; BHAVINI built and commissioned it.
new.angle: U0751 #4/#21 PFBR designer vs builder (PYQ y411e1d7ebac angle)

new.s: BHAVINI, a public sector undertaking of the Department of Atomic Energy set up in 2003, builds and operates which type of reactors?
new.x: BHAVINI was set up to build and run fast breeder reactors such as the PFBR at Kalpakkam.

new.s: The design of the Fast Breeder Test Reactor (FBTR) at Kalpakkam is based on which French reactor?
new.x: FBTR, critical in 1985, was designed on the lines of the French fast reactor Rapsodie.

new.s: Which of the following substances is used in the control rods of a nuclear reactor?
new.x: Control rods absorb neutrons to control the chain reaction; boron and cadmium are used for them.

new.s: What is the function of control rods in a nuclear reactor?
o: To absorb neutrons and control the rate of fission
To carry heat to make steam
new.x: Control rods absorb neutrons and so control the rate of the chain reaction; the moderator slows neutrons.

new.s: In which year did India join the ITER project?
new.x: India joined ITER in 2005 and supplies its cryostat.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about ITER:
1. It is a tokamak based on magnetic confinement.
2. Canada is one of its members.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: ITER at Cadarache is a magnetic-confinement tokamak; its members are the EU, India, China, Japan, South Korea, Russia and USA, not Canada.

new.s: Where was the first fusion ignition with net energy gain achieved in December 2022?
o: National Ignition Facility, Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory, USA
new.x: The National Ignition Facility at Lawrence Livermore (USA) achieved fusion ignition using lasers in December 2022.

new.s: What is India's rank in the world in thorium reserves?
new.x: India holds about 25% of world thorium and has the third-largest thorium reserve.

new.s: In which year was the Department of Atomic Energy (DAE) set up?
new.x: The DAE was set up in 1954; the Atomic Energy Act came in 1948.

new.s: CODENE, a centre for Small Modular Reactor design and safety, has been set up at which institution?
new.x: CODENE at IIT Hyderabad works on SMR design and safety (June 2026).

new.s: Ranastalam in Srikakulam district of Andhra Pradesh is the proposed site of which nuclear power project?
new.x: The Kovvada project (six AP1000 reactors with the USA) is proposed at Ranastalam, Srikakulam.
